# Original demonstration images

`interior-demo.png` and `floor-plan-demo.png` are original Madori illustrations. They are not photographs or plans of actual Properties. Both images include a visible demonstration label.

The corresponding `room.html` and `floor-plan.html` files contain their SVG source. Open each file in a browser at 960 × 640 and save a viewport PNG to reproduce the fixture. The sources need no network access or additional packages.

Use these files only for clearly marked local demonstration Listings and image upload tests. Do not present them as actual Property media.
